voice_quality_supertonic3_hint: Supertonic 3: natural voices in every language here, ten of them, generated on your device. Downloaded once (about {size} MB).

voice_test_failed: This voice could not speak right now; stories would use the standard voice instead.
voice_model_hint: Higher quality voices are larger and can take more time to load. All voices run on your device.
wordle_length_explain: Wordle length sets how many letters the target word has. Shorter words are quicker to solve, longer words give you more combinations to think through.
backwards_explain: When this is on, the game also accepts words spelled in reverse. For example, “STOP” counts the same as “POTS”.
share_app_text: Practise German with vocabulary, grammar and stories in short exercises.
models_unsupported: Needs WebGPU – not available on this device.

changelog_v1_0_0: The first version: streaks, daily goal, review, stories, writing and more.
changelog_v1_1_0: Dates, times and numbers now look like they do in the language you learn, and this page shows what's new.
readiness_hint: Estimated from your answers in the last 30 days. The range narrows the more you practise.
changelog_v1_2_0: Your progress per skill, smarter reviews and a definition for every German word.
changelog_v1_3_0: New faces, eyes and noses to unlock, a progress page just for the language you learn, and updates with Lilith.
welcome_body: A few minutes a day, and new words stick. Three friends learn with you.
welcome_meet_tom: Hi, I'm Tom! With me you practise new words until they stick.
welcome_meet_mia: And I'm Mia. I take you into stories and show you the grammar behind them.
welcome_meet_lilith: Meow! I'm Lilith. I'm happy about every day you practise – and you're allowed to pet me, too.
welcome_done_body: Mia, Tom and Lilith are waiting. Start with a short game.
placement_intro: Lilith shows you words. Tap “I know it” if you know what a word means. A few words are made up – for those tap “Don't know”. Takes about three minutes.
placement_note: Guessing doesn't pay: made-up words count against you.
placement_result_body: That's how many words you already know. Your practice adapts to it.
placement_unavailable: There aren't enough words in this language for a placement test yet.
readiness_forecast: At this pace you'll know 80 % of the {level} words in about {weeks} weeks ({low}–{high}).
today_feature: Practise {feature} – that's where most of your mistakes are right now
grade_model_needed: Without a download, fixed rules grade your texts. For an AI grade right on your device, download the model once ({model}, {size}).
grade_model_failed: The model couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
grade_model_unsupported: Your device can't run the AI model (no WebGPU), so your texts are graded by fixed rules.
models_state_downloaded_hint: Stored on the device. It loads into memory for a moment the first time it is used.
grade_model_in_memory: {model} is in memory and grades right away.
grade_model_on_device: {model} is downloaded. The first grade loads it into memory for a moment.
grade_model_loading_rules: Until the model is ready, fixed rules grade your texts.
grade_rules_chosen: Your texts are graded without AI, by fixed rules: length, punctuation, capitalisation and word variety.
mobile_data_body: {name} downloads {size}. That can use up your data plan – on Wi-Fi it's free.
placement_intro_exam: Answer short exam questions on word meanings, articles and grammar. The test starts at your level and adapts. If you don't know something, tap “I don't know” – wrong guesses count against you. Takes about five minutes.
coach_no_data: Play a few rounds and your progress fills in.
coach_focus_due_hint: Due – a quick review keeps them in memory
account_sign_out_confirm: Sign out on this device? Your progress stays here and in your Telegram account.
account_unavailable: Telegram can't be reached right now.
readiness_how_coverage: The share of the {level} words you have started learning: you can't understand a text whose words you never met. Right now: {percent} %.
readiness_how_accuracy: For each skill, the share of your answers in the last {days} days that were right. Recent answers count more: an answer from ten days ago counts half. Without any answers, 50 % is assumed.
readiness_how_skill: Readiness = coverage × accuracy. For writing and speaking, half of it is the average score of your last three texts or pronunciations.
readiness_how_range: With no answers the range is ±25 points; it narrows to ±5 as answers come in (certainty {answers40} % after 40 answers, {answers100} % after 100).
readiness_how_level: The big number averages the six skills, each counting the same, rounded to steps of 5 %. It is about the language level, not one particular exam.
cosmetic_hint_invite: Invite {count} friends who join WordCircle through your link.
invite_goal: {count} of {target} friends · then your character gets an exclusive Telegram-blue top
webgpu_ok: Works – on-device AI (voices, chat model, grading) can run here.
webgpu_no_api: This browser has no WebGPU. AI voices and the chat model stay off; everything else works without them.
webgpu_no_adapter: No usable graphics adapter was found, so AI models stay off.
webgpu_no_device: The graphics adapter would not start, so AI models stay off.
webgpu_compute_failed: WebGPU started but computed wrong results, so AI models stay off.
webgpu_not_run: Not checked yet – it runs on its own before the first AI model.
group_game_best: New best on the group's board: {score}!
group_game_hint: Your best round counts on the group's leaderboard in Telegram.
store_intro: Dress up your character and support WordCircle with Telegram Stars. Everything you learn stays free.
store_pro_benefit: One missed day a week does not break your streak – before any of your freezes is used.
store_pro_terms: {stars} ⭐ every 30 days · cancel any time in Telegram
store_failed: The store can't be reached right now.
store_sign_in: Sign in with Telegram to buy – your purchases are saved to your account.
store_link_hint: Customise your character, get new colours and Pro.
background_offer_text: You can play something else now – this keeps preparing. The small badge in the corner shows how far it is and tells you when it's ready.
dictionary_search: Search a word or a meaning
dictionary_none: No word found. Try the base form, e.g. “gehen” instead of “ging”.
home_dictionary: Look up every word of your language, with forms and compounds – offline.
goal_date_hint: Pick a date and the coach tells you whether your pace gets you there.
goal_on_track: {weeks} weeks left – at your pace you'll make it.
goal_tight: {weeks} weeks left – it will be tight; a little more each day helps.
goal_behind: {weeks} weeks left – at this pace it takes longer. Practise more often or pick a later date.
goal_unknown: {weeks} weeks left – practise a few days so the coach can tell your pace.
goal_passed: The date has passed – pick a new one.
placement_listening: Listen: what does the word mean?
alltag_time: How do you say this time?
alltag_date: How do you say this date?

alltag_price: How do you say this price?
offline_pill: Offline – keep learning, everything is saved

rubric_range_detail: {value} % different words, about {expected} % at this level.

rubric_coherence_detail: {value} different linking words, {expected} at this level.
mock_heading: A mock test for your level
mock_intro: Reading, listening, language and a writing task, as in an exam: you only see what was right at the end. You pass from {pass}, and no part may be under {min}. Takes about 15 minutes.
mock_best: Your best result at this level: {percent}
mock_unavailable: This language doesn't have enough word meanings for a mock test yet.
coach_focus_feature_prior: Often tricky when your first language is {language}
grammar_forms_unsupported: Forms are only available for German so far.
home_forms: Conjugate verbs and decline adjectives yourself, with partial credit for small slips.
